cic-cic:lever:cd431e51-e30a-4768-81d8-4a.title: Community Operations Coordinator - Cambridge, MA
cic-cic:lever:cd431e51-e30a-4768-81d8-4a.description: Are you passionate about helping people? Are you inspired by meeting new people who are doing interesting things? Do you have hands-on experience building furniture or troubleshooting technical devices or are you excited to learn how? If so, read on! CIC is looking for a full-time, early career Coordinator to join our team. This is a great opportunity for someone with at least one year of professional work experience who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment. YOUR DAY-TO-DAY WORK You will join a Community Operations Team to satisfy the day-to-day needs of our members. Some work will be independent while at other times it will require collaboration with other CIC staff members. Potential responsibilities will include: • Building and keeping good relationships with CIC members, making sure they’re happy by quickly and specifically responding to their questions and needs. • Handling a variety of member requests creatively and effectively, from office rearrangement to event hosting. • Stocking and maintaining supplies in kitchens and conference rooms, while also ensuring the upkeep of regular systems like print stations and conference room setups, offering assistance as needed. • Facilitating new member onboarding, including system registration and office setup, as well as assisting existing ones with office moves and special event preparations in conference rooms. • Supporting CIC Cambridge’s front desk operations for ~15% of your time with a focus on excellent service. This includes required staffing CIC One Broadway’s front desk during Venture Café on Thursdays 4PM - 6:30PM approximately every 3 weeks. • Assisting other teams with special projects as needed. • Helping cover other operations teams as needed • Organizing community events to encourage networking among members. ABOUT YOU We value service-minded, reliable, and independent thinkers who may not know everything on day one but are bright, curious, and eager to learn. As our ideal candidate, you should confidently take ownership of tasks, be personable and enjoy helping others, and possess a self-motivated attitude towards learning our business in-depth. Your approach should be detail-oriented and organized, with strong time management skills. You're expected to be a team player who can maintain positive relationships and communicate professionally, treating everyone equally and contributing fresh ideas. YOU HAVE • A bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. • At least one year of professional experience. • A natural interest for helping/supporting others. • An interest in a long-term role. We are a growing company, and we like to hire people who can grow with us over the years. OUR OFFER • Starting compensation is $53,000 per year. • 100% company-paid premium healthcare and dental benefits. • 100% company-paid long and short-term disability, and life insurance. • 401k (must be 21+). • 18 days of PTO accrued annually (more with seniority), plus thirteen paid holidays from the start. ATTRACTIONS OF THE JOB In addition to helping our members achieve great things, we work to ensure that our employees are healthy and supported. Some of the benefits of being here include: • Fun people in a dynamic space. We pride ourselves on finding driven and bright collaborators who are eager to lend their own unique skills to the team, as well as to our inspiring members. The number one reason CICers say they like working here is because of their colleagues! • Personal growth. This is a great opportunity to learn and develop skills within the epicenter of the innovation community at a growing company. • Access to a nursing room, secure bicycle parking, a maker space, a gym, shower rooms with towels, and discounted services and memberships on resources to make your life happier/healthier such as gym memberships, tech and design support, hotel stays, and other fantastic options. • Central location. CIC Cambridge is a stone’s throw from the Kendall Square MBTA Red Line stop. ABOUT CIC

jobgether-jobgether:lever:e88bb668-419a-.title: ServiceNow Application Developer / Programmer Senior
jobgether-jobgether:lever:e88bb668-419a-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a ServiceNow Application Developer / Programmer Senior based in Canada. Take ownership of ServiceNow solutions that support critical asset management and technology operations. You’ll lead the implementation and ongoing management of Hardware Asset Management, Software Asset Management, and Software Bill of Materials capabilities. The role combines hands-on development and platform expertise with requirements gathering, inventory management, and process improvement. You’ll collaborate with technical teams and stakeholders to translate business needs into effective, scalable solutions. Your work will help strengthen technology visibility, control, and operational efficiency across a mission-focused environment. You’ll use ServiceNow and Azure technologies while working independently on complex technical challenges. This is a senior opportunity for an experienced professional who wants to apply their expertise to meaningful, high-impact technology initiatives. Lead the implementation, configuration, and ongoing management of ServiceNow Hardware Asset Management and Software Asset Management capabilities. Implement and manage Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) solutions to strengthen software visibility, tracking, and governance. Develop and maintain ServiceNow applications and platform capabilities in line with operational and business requirements. Collaborate with internal technical teams and stakeholders to gather, clarify, document, and deliver requirements effectively. Drive technology inventory management and control, ensuring asset information remains accurate, accessible, and well governed. Apply ServiceNow administration and development expertise to optimize platform functionality and support evolving requirements. Utilize Azure technologies alongside ServiceNow to deliver effective technology solutions and integrations. Troubleshoot technical issues, identify opportunities for improvement, and implement sustainable solutions. Contribute technical leadership and expertise throughout implementation and operational activities, ensuring solutions are reliable and maintainable. Requirements: 8+ years of relevant professional experience in software engineering, application development, ServiceNow, or a related technical field. Technical training, professional certification, or a degree in a relevant technology or engineering discipline. Strong hands-on experience with ServiceNow administration, implementation, and application development. Demonstrated expertise with ServiceNow Hardware Asset Management and Software Asset Management. Experience working with Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) solutions and related inventory or software asset management processes. Strong understanding of the ServiceNow platform and its capabilities for enterprise asset management. Experience with Azure technologies and cloud-based environments. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate requirements into practical technical solutions. Excellent collaboration and communication skills, particularly when working with technical and business stakeholders. Ability to work independently, manage priorities effectively, and take ownership of complex technical initiatives. A strong focus on accuracy, system reliability, security, and continuous improvement. U.S. citizenship is not required for this position; however, the role requires eligibility to obtain the applicable BI Full 6C (T4) public trust clearance . Benefits: Competitive annual salary range of approximately $136,000–$184,000 USD , depending on experience, location, and other applicable factors. Fully remote working arrangement. Full-flex work week designed to provide flexibility in managing professional and personal priorities. Comprehensive medical plan options, including plans with Health Savings Accounts. Dental and vision coverage.

lightfield-lightfield:ashbyhq:156e5bba-b.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure (Staff)
lightfield-lightfield:ashbyhq:156e5bba-b.description: ABOUT LIGHTFIELD Lightfield is an AI-native CRM that assembles itself from your email, calendar, and meetings. It captures every interaction and turns it into organized context: accounts, tasks, follow-ups, and insights, so nothing slips through the cracks. We’re rethinking CRM from first principles. Instead of forcing teams to maintain rigid systems, Lightfield learns from how companies actually work, adapting, automating, and surfacing the insight that drives growth. We’re building the CRM platform we always wished existed: fast, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. The market agrees. Over 5,000 companies have used Lightfield since we launched in November, making us the fastest-adopted product in our category. We are backed by Greylock, Lightspeed, and Coatue, and our founders previously built Tome, a generative AI presentation product used by over 25 million people. Before Lightfield, our team worked on Llama, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, Pinterest, Google, and Salesforce. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for an experienced, creative, and versatile engineer who is eager to tackle the challenge of architecting, building, and scaling the core infrastructure and systems powering Lightfield's AI-driven CRM. At Lightfield, engineers take ownership of projects from inception to impact, collaborating across functions and pushing the envelope on what’s possible in applied AI and data systems. You’ll play a critical role in designing and building the data models and infrastructure that support a next-generation CRM, ensuring our system is performant, scalable, and resilient. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Build and maintain full-stack systems, end-to-end, ensuring reliability, scalability, and performance. - Architect and scale the data infrastructure and backend services that power Lightfield AI-driven CRM. - Design and optimize data models to support CRM workflows, customer interactions, and AI-driven insights. - Develop observability and metrics to enable smooth operation, proactive issue detection, and continuous improvement. - Mentor teammates, participate in code reviews, and help shape engineering culture and practices. - Contribute to building a world-class engineering team through recruiting, mentorship, and knowledge-sharing. WHO YOU ARE - 7+ years of experience in software development, with a strong background in infrastructure, data modeling, and backend systems. - Deep experience building scalable, high-performance data infrastructure that can support complex customer workflows and large-scale data processing. - Strong understanding of database design, indexing strategies, and query optimization, especially in PostgreSQL or similar relational databases. - You’re excited about Large Language Models (LLMs) and the opportunity to build systems that support and leverage them. - You have the ability to ramp quickly on tech stack that features TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Apollo GraphQL, and PostgreSQL. - Strong fundamentals in software engineering, with a degree in Computer Science or a related field. - Thrives in ambiguity, able to independently drive projects and deliver results in a fast-moving environment. - Clear communicator, capable of articulating technical decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. - Passionate about building products customers love, ensuring our CRM is intuitive, intelligent, and indispensable. BENEFITS & PERKS - Competitive salary - Meaningful early equity - Health insurance (medical, dental, vision) - 3 weeks of PTO - 11 paid company holidays + we enjoy a winter holiday break - 3 months of paid family leave - Wednesdays work from home - Regular team dinners, events, offsites, and retreats - 401k plan - Other perks include: commuter and lunch stipend

roadrunnerstudios-roadrunner-studios:lev.description: Facility Manager, Roadrunner Quantum Lab Roadrunner Venture Studios is the nation’s leading platform for founding breakthrough ventures in deep technology. Our mission is to turn frontier tech into breakthrough companies for the benefit of the American people. Together with engineers, scientists, and entrepreneurs, we build products, create business models, recruit teams, align companies with their first customers, and provide initial funding. Our Venture Studios focuses on advanced energy, advanced materials, advanced manufacturing, and quantum technologies. The Opportunity The Roadrunner Quantum Lab (RQL) is New Mexico's flagship quantum innovation facility, bringing together startups, national laboratories, researchers, corporate partners, and government stakeholders under one roof. We're looking for a Facility Manager who serves as the operational concierge for the Roadrunner Quantum Lab. This person is the first point of contact for everything related to the facility, ensuring issues are addressed quickly and the right resources are brought in to resolve them. Whether coordinating a plumber, electrician, HVAC contractor, security vendor, or other specialist, the Facility Manager owns the outcome and delivers a seamless, concierge-level experience for tenants, visitors, and partners. The Role The Facility Manager is responsible for the daily operation, maintenance, and overall functionality of the Roadrunner Quantum Lab. Acting as the facility concierge, you are the operational hub of the building. You ensure the facility, shared spaces, vendors, tenants, visitors, and building infrastructure operate seamlessly. Rather than performing specialized trade work yourself, you identify issues, engage the appropriate experts, oversee their work, and ensure every request is resolved efficiently and professionally. This role requires someone who enjoys ownership, anticipates problems before they arise, and delivers an exceptional service experience. Your success will be measured not by fixing every issue personally, but by ensuring the facility consistently operates at the highest level. What You'll Do Facility Operations Serve as the facility concierge and primary point of contact for all building-related requests. Oversee the day-to-day operation of the facility, ensuring the building is safe, clean, functional, and ready for daily use. Deliver responsive, concierge-level service to tenants, visitors, and partners. Coordinate repairs, maintenance, and building improvements by engaging and managing qualified vendors and contractors. Track maintenance requests from identification through completion, ensuring timely resolution. Conduct routine facility walkthroughs to proactively identify maintenance or operational issues. Coordinate preventive maintenance schedules for building systems and equipment. Maintain inventories of facility supplies and oversee purchasing as needed. Ensure conference rooms, laboratories, offices, and shared spaces remain operational, organized, and presentation-ready. Vendor & Building Management Manage relationships with landlords, property management, contractors, maintenance vendors, janitorial providers, internet providers, security companies, and other service partners. Coordinate specialized vendors—including plumbing, HVAC, electrical, fire protection, networking, access control, and other building systems—ensuring the appropriate experts are engaged whenever needed. Act as the single concierge point of coordination for all maintenance, repairs, and facility improvement projects. Schedule vendor visits, oversee work performed, and verify projects are completed on time and to a high standard. Manage service contracts, vendor performance, warranties, and preventive maintenance agreements. Obtain quotes, coordinate purchasing, and support facility budgeting. triedgeinvestments-triedge-investments:a.description: Salud Healthcare Salud Healthcare is transforming how value-based care is delivered by empowering provider organizations with data-driven insights, modern technology, and operational excellence. As a rapidly growing Management Services Organization (MSO), Salud partners with physician groups to improve patient outcomes, optimize clinical performance, and navigate the complexities of value-based care. Our technology platform serves as the connective tissue between providers, payers, analytics, and operations—helping healthcare organizations close care gaps, improve quality outcomes, and drive better financial performance. We are building the next generation of healthcare applications that power population health management, risk adjustment, care coordination, analytics, and provider engagement. Position Summary Salud Healthcare is seeking a Director of Software Engineering to help architect, build, and scale the technology foundation that powers our value-based care platform. This is a hands-on, player-coach role for an experienced engineer who enjoys balancing software development, technical leadership, architecture, and mentorship. You will serve as a key technical partner to the VP of Technology & Data Analytics, helping transform healthcare business requirements into scalable software solutions that support providers, payers, and operational teams. You will lead development across a portfolio of healthcare applications spanning population health analytics, care management, risk adjustment, provider engagement, and operational workflows. While this role includes leadership responsibilities, we are specifically looking for someone who remains close to the code, enjoys solving complex technical problems, and can lead through technical credibility rather than organizational hierarchy. The ideal candidate brings a strong combination of healthcare technology experience, software architecture expertise, and practical engineering leadership. They understand how healthcare data moves through systems, can navigate provider and payer workflows, and possess the judgment to build durable solutions that balance immediate business needs with long-term platform scalability. Success in this role will be measured by your ability to establish scalable technical foundations, deliver production-ready applications, improve engineering practices, reduce technical debt, and serve as a trusted technical advisor across technology, analytics, operations, and executive leadership.
